name: colyseus-chat
description: Colyseus + Svelte 聊天室（monorepo：shared / server / client）

scripts.build: bun run --filter @colyseus-chat/shared build && bun run --filter server build && bun run --filter client build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @colyseus-chat/shared typecheck && bun run --filter server typecheck && bun run --filter client check
